rules.source_quote: the girl should be unmarried and should be below 16 years of age (as on 31st March) on joining class IX
rules.note: Age is measured as on 31st March of the year of joining class IX, not today's age.

rules.source_quote: To be eligible for the benefit under the scheme the girl should be unmarried
rules.note: Scheme covers girls only; the profile field is_woman is used as the closest fact for a girl child.

unresolved: MISSING FIELD: is_married / marital status (NSIGSE-IN-ELIGIBILITY-02 and EXCLUSION-01: girl must be unmarried, married girls excluded).
MISSING FIELD: caste or tribe category (SC/ST girls; KGBV passouts are covered regardless).
MISSING FIELD: is_student, education level (passed class VIII, enrolled in class IX) and school type (government/aided/local body covered; private unaided and Central Government schools excluded).
Age condition is 'below 16 as on 31st March on joining class IX', which is not the same as current age; the rule is a rough proxy.
